question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Gross margin (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: On the Aug 26 2026 Q2 FY27 call, CFO Kress pre-signaled that Q4 FY27 gross margin would trough at 71-72% because of memory price spikes, after 75.0% in Q2 and a 74.0% ±50bp Q3 guide. The Q3 release will give a formal Q4 GAAP guide in 'X% ±50bp' form, and NVIDIA usually guides close to what it pre-signals, so the mode is about 71.5. Downside tilt: memory prices are 'headed even higher', Rubin ramp costs, and GAAP has sat up to 0.2pt below non-GAAP. Upside: earlier price increases or memory relief. Live web tools failed this run (API errors, curl blocked), so all evidence comes from the repo's Oct 7-8 2026 research traces, and the market check could not be re-run live. Those traces found no human market (Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold, bookmakers) on this guide.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the facts: Q2 GM 75.0%, Q3 guide 74.0% ±50bp, and the CFO's Q4 'trough 71-72%' remark on the Aug 26 call. The one open factual question, whether that band is GAAP or non-GAAP, can't be settled from the dossiers. It matters little because the FY27 GAAP/non-GAAP gap is 0-0.1pt. I also note that all three runs drew on the same earlier saved research and shared secondary sources for the 71-72 quote, so they are not independent confirmations. For that I add a slightly wider upper tail (p90 72.4) and a little more above-range mass. I agree with the runs' reference class and carry it forward.
